items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He was very easy to get along with. He'd never bother you about nothin'.

ctx.x: Can you tell me some more about A.G. Allen? What kind of individual was he? Was he easy to get along with?

He was very easy to get along with. He'd never bother you about nothin'. All he'd do, he wanted to put on a good show. Put on a good show and receive that money. They used to come... I think during that time to see the show was... I think it was fifty cents, or seventy-five cents, something like that. And the main thing to have the people come in there, we had to make that parade round about two or three o'clock in the afternoon.
This would be during the week or on Saturdays?
